overall.summary: Logitech appears to have systematically removed multiple material risk factors from its 10-Q filing, including detailed trade/tariff risk disclosure (at a time of escalating U.S.-China tariffs), debt/financing risk with specific credit facility details, cybersecurity/data privacy risk, and liquidity/covenant compliance risk.
